research.facts:
Duren Deadline — 8 Days, Pistons Up to $200M
**Source: basketballforever.com (Sept. 21, 2026)**
- Pistons upped Duren offer to $200 million (five-year deal); previous offer was ~$190M (~$35M/yr average)
- Duren seeking closer to $287M max (five-year max for third-team All-NBA)
- QO deadline: Oct. 1, 2026 (8 days away from today)
- Hard deadline for long-term deal: March 1, 2027
- Duren QO value: $9.6M
- Duren stats 2025-26: 19.5 pts, 10.5 reb, 2.0 ast
- Duren honors: first All-Star selection, third-team All-NBA
- Pistons record 2025-26: 60 wins, Eastern Conference No. 1 seed
- Duren age: 22
- Detroit media day: Sept. 28 at 1:30 PM (Trajan Langdon and J.B. Bickerstaff speak)
- Duren's Sept. 28 media day attendance uncertain
- Confidence: HIGH (multiple sources)
**Source: fadeawayworld.net, hoopshype.com, clutchpoints.com**
- Duren "increasingly prepared" to accept QO
- If Duren takes QO: becomes unrestricted FA summer 2027
- Kings monitoring situation; confirmed earlier reports
- Confidence: HIGH

**Source: AP (via cp24.com, kiro7.com, hoopshype.com, Sept. 22, 2026)**
- Extension announced: Sept. 22, 2026
- Terms: 2 years, $115 million; includes player option for 2028-29
- Leonard's current existing contract: $50M remaining (per context of re-acquisition)
- Total under contract: 3 seasons, $165 million
- Leonard took $11M less than max extension number
- Waived $7.45M kicker to give Raptors salary flexibility
- Re-acquired from LA Clippers in July 2026
- Raptors and Leonard had "constant dialogue" since July
- Leonard "expected to finish his career in Toronto"
- Confidence: HIGH (AP source, multiple outlets)

research.facts:
Ausar Thompson 5-Year, $155M Extension
**Source: ESPN, Washington Post, NBA.com, CBS Detroit (Sept. 19, 2026)**
- Extension agreed: ~Sept. 19, 2026
- Terms: 5 years, $155 million, fully guaranteed
- Rookie-scale extension
- Thompson age: 23
- 2025-26 stats: 9.9 pts, 5.7 reb, 3.1 ast, 0.9 blk, 2.0 stl/game (led NBA in steals)
- Honors: First-team All-Defense, finished third in Defensive Player of the Year voting
- Context: Extension talks had stalled over the summer before agreement
- Twins milestone: Ausar (Pistons, $155M) + Amen Thompson (Houston Rockets) = combined $363M — first brothers in NBA history to each receive $100M+ contracts
- Confidence: HIGH (AP source, multiple outlets)
